description: This Java source file defines the RabbitMQPublisherActor class, which is responsible for publishing ExternalMessages into RabbitMQ/AMQP 0.9.1 within the Eclipse Ditto project. It manages message publishing, acknowledgment handling, exchange declaration, and RabbitMQ confirmation modes, facilitating reliable message delivery in a messaging system.

classes.name: RabbitMQPublisherActor
classes.description: A final class extending BasePublisherActor responsible for publishing messages to RabbitMQ with management of confirmations, acknowledgments, and exchange declarations.

classes.name: ChannelStatus
classes.description: A private static class representing the status of the channel, including any confirmation exceptions and target resource statuses.

classes.name: ActorConfirmListener
classes.description: A private static class implementing ConfirmListener and ReturnListener to handle acknowledgments and returned messages from RabbitMQ.

classes.name: OutstandingAck
classes.description: A private static class representing an outstanding acknowledgment for a published message, with methods to complete with success or failure.

classes.name: ConfirmMode
classes.description: An enum representing the confirmation mode state: UNKNOWN, ACTIVE, or INACTIVE.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates an Akka Props configuration object for RabbitMQPublisherActor with the specified Connection.

methods.name: shouldPublishAcknowledgement
methods.description: Overrides to determine if an acknowledgment should be published based on its label.

methods.name: preEnhancement
methods.description: Sets up message handling for channel creation and status within Akka actor receive builder.

methods.name: postEnhancement
methods.description: Placeholder for additional message handling logic, currently noop.

methods.name: toPublishTarget
methods.description: Converts an address string into a RabbitMQTarget object.

methods.name: publishMessage
methods.description: Publishes an ExternalMessage to RabbitMQ, handling message properties, body encoding, and acknowledging confirm modes.

methods.name: computeNextPublishSeqNoConsumer
methods.description: Determines the consumer for the next publish sequence number, based on confirmation mode.

methods.name: addOutstandingAck
methods.description: Adds an outstanding acknowledgment for a published message, with timeout handling and indexing.

methods.name: handleChannelStatus
methods.description: Handles updates to channel status, including confirmation mode changes and target statuses.

methods.name: onChannelCreated
methods.description: Callback invoked when a new channel is created, sets confirmation mode and declares exchanges.

methods.name: getTimeoutAck
methods.description: Builds an acknowledgment indicating a timeout.

methods.name: getUnsupportedAck
methods.description: Builds an acknowledgment indicating the broker does not support publisher confirms.

methods.name: buildAcknowledgement
methods.description: Helper method to create acknowledgment objects with specific status and messages.

methods.name: declareExchangesPassive
methods.description: Passively declares exchanges to verify their existence, updates target statuses accordingly.

methods.name: tryToEnterConfirmationMode
methods.description: Attempts to set the channel into confirmation mode, returning exception if fails.

methods.name: enterConfirmationMode
methods.description: Sets the RMQ channel into confirm mode with listeners for confirms and returns.

methods.name: sendFailedFuture
methods.description: Creates a failed CompletableFuture with a message.
